title: Farsi with Mass
goal: Real conversations with Massoumeh now; reading and writing by summer 2027.

week.screen: About 20–25 minutes on the laptop, 5 days a week. Longer days get the extras (roots, verse, gossip).
week.paper: About 10 minutes in the notebook every lesson. Tracing sheets print from each day.
week.kitchen: Every day: one conversation card with Mass. Weekends: a longer one, sometimes in public.

tracks.name: Talk
tracks.desc: One household scene per chapter, a daily card for Mass, and from Chapter 5, unscripted speaking.

tracks.name: Verb lab
tracks.desc: Full tables, every tense learned so far, six persons, with negatives. About 40 core verbs and the dozen helpers that build thousands more.

tracks.name: Ear gym
tracks.desc: Minimal pairs in two voices, spoken-vs-written rules, shadowing with recording, and Mass-speed clips.

tracks.name: Reading & writing
tracks.desc: 10 letters a week until the alphabet is done, then decoding, then real texts, then writing.

tracks.name: Word stories & verse
tracks.desc: Word families, roots, and a line of Persian poetry each chapter.

tracks.name: Home
tracks.desc: Teach the girls, kitchen labels, the gossip kit.

milestones.text: Yalda night: read your first fāl-e Hafez with Mass
First unhelped gossip walk: 5 minutes in public, all Farsi
Nowruz: hold up your end of the family visits, tarof included
Read a children’s story aloud to the girls
Write Mass a letter in Persian script, and read her reply
